# Version 4.156.0
> **Skia m156 preview** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.156.0-preview.1.26512.10)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.156.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.4.0.100/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.156.0 previews the Skia m156 renderer with GTK4 GPU rendering and updated platform assets. It restores Linux system-font discovery for NoDependencies deployments and aligns native packages with current .NET, Windows, and Tizen toolchains.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m156** — Moves the bundled renderer to Skia m156 and integrates the remaining m155 core-fork cleanup. ([#5208](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5208), [#5247](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5247))

## Platform

- **GTK4 gains native GPU rendering** — Adds native GPU rendering and pixel scaling for GTK4 applications. ([#5249](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5249))
- **Linux system-font discovery restored** — NoDependencies deployments on Linux can again discover installed system fonts. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5086](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5086))
- **Native assets align with current platforms** — Updates WebAssembly assets for .NET 11 previews, restores the WinUI Windows SDK default, and packages Tizen builds with GCC 14.2. ([#5235](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5235), [#5273](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5273), [#5306](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5306))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.4.0.100

Aligns HarfBuzzSharp native assets with the .NET 11 preview, current Windows toolchain, and Tizen GCC 14.2 builds.
